newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CBR H1 96 group net profit rises.
newsitem.headline: CBR H1 96 group net profit rises.

text.p: NOTE: CBR is a leading Belgian cement maker
Cons profit pre extra items 2.411 vs 2.774

CBR said sales in Western Europe fell to 13.9 billion francs from 14.1 billion. In Central Europe sales slipped to 2.9 billion francs from 3.0, while in North America they rose to 7.5 billion francs from 6.8. Sales in Turkey, reported for the first time following the group's acquisitions there, were 1.5 billion francs.
The company said that in Western Europe a combination of bad weather and tough markets in the early part of the year hurt the results for the first half.
The picture in Central Europe was patchy, although CBR said there were definite signs of improvement in the Czech Republic and Poland after the hard winter.

In North America sales of ready-mixed concrete jumped but aggregates fell. CBD said the economic slowdown and bad weather affected sales in British Columbia, while Washington State and Oregon had strong growth, as did California.
